observations: Photo 0: A wooden pallet on a concrete floor; visible stringers and deck boards; some wear and discoloration.
Photo 1: Another angle of the same pallet; multiple rectangular cut-outs/openings in the deck; no clear size markings.
Photo 2: Stacked pallets in a warehouse; pallets show mixed wear; some boards look slightly uneven but no obvious broken frame in the visible faces.
No readable brand/model on the pallets; only watermark text appears on the images.

claims.evidence: Photos show wooden pallets suitable for storage, but do not show the exact pallet standard/spec (e.g., ISPM/HT markings, dimensions, or grade).

risks.risk: Pallet condition/structural integrity (cracked or weak boards, loose nails/screws) affecting load capacity.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four edges and underside (where stringers meet deck boards), plus a short video showing a gentle lift/test for flex.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/average condition with possible minor damage (not guaranteed for heavy-load use).

risks.risk: Missing or non-compliant treatment markings (e.g., HT/IPPC) for export or certain uses.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of any stamp/markings on the pallet deck or side rails (including any ISPM/HT/IPPC codes).

risks.risk: Size/grade mismatch (some pallets may be different dimensions or have fewer deck boards).
risks.proof: Provide exact measurements (length, width, height) and a photo with a measuring tape on the pallet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic standard-size used pallet without premium grade.

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (seller may be selling a bundle of pallets; photos show multiple but not the exact count).
risks.proof: Count confirmation: photo showing the full stack with a visible count or a statement of exact number of pallets included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per pallet as a worst-case single-unit basis.

proof_requests: Exact pallet dimensions (L×W×H) with a measuring tape in the photo.
Clear close-up of any treatment stamps/markings (HT/IPPC/ISPM) on the wood.
Underside + all four edges close-ups to confirm no broken stringers and board integrity.
Confirm the exact quantity of pallets included in the sale (count).
response.reason: From the photos, these are wooden storage pallets in used condition, but key pricing drivers are unverified remotely: exact pallet standard/size, treatment markings, structural integrity, and the exact quantity included.
